_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "boutiques" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "maj_le" TEXT NOT NULL, "supprime_le" TEXT NULL, "synchro" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("synchro" IN (0, 1)), "appareil_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "nom" TEXT NOT NULL, "telephone" TEXT NOT NULL, "ville" TEXT NOT NULL, "quartier" TEXT NOT NULL, "type_commerce" TEXT NOT NULL, "seuil_alerte_defaut" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("seuil_alerte_defaut" >= 0), "cree_le" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "utilisateurs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "maj_le" TEXT NOT NULL, "supprime_le" TEXT NULL, "synchro" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("synchro" IN (0, 1)), "appareil_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "boutique_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES boutiques (id), "nom" TEXT NOT NULL, "telephone" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'proprietaire' CHECK("role" IN ('proprietaire', 'vendeur')), "code_pin" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "maj_le" TEXT NOT NULL, "supprime_le" TEXT NULL, "synchro" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("synchro" IN (0, 1)), "appareil_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "nom" TEXT NOT NULL, "icone" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "produits" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "maj_le" TEXT NOT NULL, "supprime_le" TEXT NULL, "synchro" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("synchro" IN (0, 1)), "appareil_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "categorie_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "nom" TEXT NOT NULL, "prix_achat" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("prix_achat" >= 0), "prix_vente" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("prix_vente" >= 0), "quantite" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "unite" TEXT NOT NULL, "seuil_alerte" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("seuil_alerte" >= 0.0), "photo_locale" TEXT NULL, "code_barre" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "clients" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "maj_le" TEXT NOT NULL, "supprime_le" TEXT NULL, "synchro" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("synchro" IN (0, 1)), "appareil_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "nom" TEXT NOT NULL, "telephone" TEXT NULL, "solde_dette" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ventes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "maj_le" TEXT NOT NULL, "supprime_le" TEXT NULL, "synchro" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("synchro" IN (0, 1)), "appareil_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "numero" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("numero" > 0), "client_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES clients (id), "utilisateur_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES utilisateurs (id), "total" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("total" >= 0), "montant_paye" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("montant_paye" >= 0), "reste_a_payer" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("reste_a_payer" >= 0), "mode_paiement" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("mode_paiement" IN ('especes', 'momo', 'orange_money', 'credit')), "benefice" INTEGER NOT NULL, "date_vente" TEXT NOT NULL, "annulee" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("annulee" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lignes_vente" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "maj_le" TEXT NOT NULL, "supprime_le" TEXT NULL, "synchro" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("synchro" IN (0, 1)), "appareil_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "vente_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ventes (id), "produit_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES produits (id), "nom_produit" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantite" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("quantite" > 0.0), "prix_unitaire" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("prix_unitaire" >= 0), "prix_achat_unitaire" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("prix_achat_unitaire" >= 0), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "versements_dette" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "maj_le" TEXT NOT NULL, "supprime_le" TEXT NULL, "synchro" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("synchro" IN (0, 1)), "appareil_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "client_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES clients (id), "montant" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("montant" > 0), "mode_paiement" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("mode_paiement" IN ('especes', 'momo', 'orange_money')), "date_versement" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mouvements_stock" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "maj_le" TEXT NOT NULL, "supprime_le" TEXT NULL, "synchro" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("synchro" IN (0, 1)), "appareil_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "produit_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES produits (id), "type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("type" IN ('entree', 'vente', 'perte', 'correction', 'annulation')), "quantite" REAL NOT NULL, "prix_achat_unitaire" INTEGER NULL, "reference_id" TEXT NULL, "date_mouvement" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
